title: The Banner of Matched Embers
summary: A school book on embers of one heat held in both hands so that paired burns land in perfect time and meet inside the guard.

title: The Hawk Stoop School Book
summary: A school book of fire that watches from above and drops on its mark in the manner of the hawk of the azure sky.

title: The Dual Pyre School Book
summary: A school book of pyres raised in kindred pairs that lean on each other and collapse together on whatever stands between.

title: The Basin Fire Signature Codex
summary: A codex of fire that gathers like water in a basin held by the qi field and pours out all at once through a single cut.

title: The Codex of the Everburning Pair
summary: A codex for the formed Core in which two flames feed each other without end and burn the longer the fight continues.

title: The Wind-Sworn Ember School Book
summary: A school book of embers carried on the breath and kept alight by a vow to the wind that none will go out unspent.

title: The Oath-Burn School Book
summary: A school book of fire spoken into being by an oath and held steady until the oath is kept or the user falls.

title: The Open Bearing Fire Book of the Wind-Sworn
summary: A school book of fire thrown in the open along a clear bearing that the wind-sworn hold against any cover.

title: The Plateau-Standing Flame Codex
summary: A codex of a flame that stands unmoved in the open wind and is fed by it until the whole stand is loosed at once.

title: The Codex of the Unsetting Fire
summary: A codex for the formed Core of a fire that is sworn never to set and that burns on through night and wind alike.
